subject.title: [Feature]: Add Ralph Loop feature and add max iteration number into the agent configuration

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated Ralph-style repeated-prompt loop default, fold this request into the broader per-agent iteration-budget contract, or reject repeated-prompt looping as outside core for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the request adds public config and runtime semantics that automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fold Into Iteration Budget
options.body: Use one opt-in OpenClaw-native iteration-budget contract that covers per-agent defaults and explicitly distinguishes intentional continuation from accidental tool loops.

options.title: Add Dedicated Ralph Loop
options.body: Add a separate repeated-prompt loop surface with explicit STOP, unlimited, interruption, restart, and transcript semantics.

options.title: Reject Core Loop Surface
options.body: Document existing alternatives through run retries, tool-loop detection, or plugin/runtime work instead of adding a new core loop mode.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Iteration Budget
recommendation.body: Use one opt-in OpenClaw-native iteration-budget contract that covers per-agent defaults and explicitly distinguishes intentional continuation from accidental tool loops.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom owns the active overlapping implementation candidate and would need to decide whether that PR absorbs, narrows, or rejects this Ralph-loop behavior.
